newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLAND GOALKEEPER SEAMAN LIKELY TO MISS TOTTENHAM CLASH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLAND GOALKEEPER SEAMAN LIKELY TO MISS TOTTENHAM CLASH.

text.p: England goalkeeper David Seaman is likely to miss Sunday's premier league clash with neighbours Tottenham after cracking ribs for the third time in his Arsenal career.
Manager Arsene Wenger said on Wednesday: "I am pessimistic at the moment. He has had x-rays but the full extent of the injury is still not clear.
"The odds are against him playing against Tottenham...But we have an extra 24 hours because the game is being played on a Sunday and we will wait as long as we can to see how he feels then."
Seaman was elbowed in the ribs during the 1-0 premier league defeat by champions Manchester United on Saturday. He completed the match but has not trained this week.
